meta.name: Rajut Langensari Retro Textile Catalog
meta.description: Katalog UMKM dengan disiplin grid Brooklyn Tweed dan kehangatan katalog Retro Bloom.
source_references: Screenshot Brooklyn Tweed desktop catalog supplied by the user
Screenshot Retro Bloom mobile catalog supplied by the user

color.palette_type: analogous with a single complementary accent

primary.role: Olive brand field for hero, announcement strip, value band, and footer

secondary.role: Oat paper background for catalog and editorial content

accent.role: Brick action color for primary CTA, price, focus, and active states

neutral.usage: Oat surfaces, olive-tinted dividers, readable ink, and charcoal dark-mode surfaces

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light catalog content, light-on-olive brand fields, and WCAG AA text contrast

font_families.heading: Bricolage Grotesque, Arial Black, system-ui, sans-serif

typography.font_style_notes: Heavy irregular grotesque headings resemble a market sign; the humanist body face keeps product and maker information calm.

spacing.section_rhythm: Compact utility bands alternate with spacious image-led sections

layout.grid_system: Fluid twelve-column editorial grid with flex rails for categories
layout.columns: 12 desktop, 2 product columns mobile, 3 product columns large desktop
layout.alignment_tendency: Asymmetric editorial alignment with strict product-card rows

shape.border_usage: Fine ink dividers and offset brick thread lines around product imagery
shape.divider_style: One-pixel hairlines and a single olive wave transition

elevation.depth_cues: Offset borders, surface color, image overlap, and sticky navigation

iconography.preferred_set: Phosphor for future controls; preserve the existing geometric chain logo

motion.entrance_pattern: Single hero rise on initial load
motion.philosophy: Functional feedback with one content-driven product ribbon

components.button_style: Pill-shaped brick primary actions and thin outlined secondary actions
components.input_style: Pill input on an oat surface with a visible label and brick focus ring
components.card_style: Borderless product information paired with a woven-label image frame
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky two-tier header, inline desktop links, compact mobile disclosure
components.modal_style: Native dialog treatment if a modal is added
components.list_style: Horizontal category rail, editorial mosaic, and responsive product grid
components.component_notes: One panel carries one message; product imagery owns the strongest framing treatment.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A textile mail-order catalog assembled from woven labels and market signage
aesthetic.era_influence: 1970s craft catalog filtered through a contemporary editorial grid

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous around stories, compact around shopping controls
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Large olive fields balanced by product photography and dark display type
visual_language.focal_strategy: Hero product first, then category choice, maker story, and catalog conversion
visual_language.texture_usage: Real product photography and fine offset label borders

composition.hierarchy_method: Scale contrast, color fields, and spatial isolation
composition.flow_direction: Top-to-bottom shopping path with one horizontal product ribbon
composition.grouping_strategy: Color blocks, image frames, and whitespace instead of nested cards
composition.negative_space_role: Separates browsing, story, and conversion moments

imagery.photo_treatment: Natural product photos cropped consistently and framed like sewn labels
imagery.illustration_style: No decorative illustration; geometric brand mark only
imagery.graphic_elements: Olive wave divider, offset brick line, and product ribbon
imagery.pattern_usage: Textile cues appear only at section transitions and product frames
imagery.image_shape: Four-by-five product portraits, square category crops, and circular category thumbnails

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Clear focus rings, color shifts, and one-pixel press movement
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Small image lift or scale and brick color transition

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: State the problem and provide one recovery action

overview.fallback_strategy: Disable animation and smooth scrolling under reduced motion

background_effects.description: Solid semantic color fields carry the composition

image_effects.description: Product images scale slightly on hover while their layout remains fixed

visual_effects.composite_notes: The visual identity relies on color blocks, real photography, an offset textile-label frame, and one CSS marquee. Heavy visual effects would compete with product clarity and low-cost Android performance.
